boundaries.sourcePrinciple: Source notes define principles and evidence boundaries; they do not silently define coordinates, paths, timing or certified answers for new boards.
boundaries.authoredBoard: Ready-made examples are coach-review drafts with authored static positions in canonical metres.
boundaries.movement: Every ready-made draft has duration 8 and exactly one key at time 0 per actor. Coach Lab player-route authoring is deployed and live-phone verified; applied points become explicit director keys. Source prose never supplies automatic movement.
boundaries.assessment: Learner positions, actions and reasons are compared with a coach reference without score, pass/fail or transfer claims.
boundaries.promotion: Examples are not approved claims or promoted curriculum.

coachPlayerRoutes.entry: Coach Lab: Plan player route from an unfrozen selected player at the captured director time, outside live practice
coachPlayerRoutes.coordinates: canonical rink metres; exact sampled Start plus 1-12 explicit destination points
views: numeric Add route point with incomplete and non-finite value rejection
coachPlayerRoutes.apply: clone the draft, preserve the selected player's keys before Start, add the exact sampled Start anchor, replace every key at or after Start, and hold the endpoint through the draft end
coachPlayerRoutes.preserve: earlier position and facing interpolation, other actors' keys, puck ownership and source metadata
coachPlayerRoutes.timing: at least 0.05 seconds inside draft duration; segment time proportional to segment length; duplicate adjacent points and near-colliding key times rejected

facing.defaultKeep: hold the sampled absolute facing direction
facing.optionalTravel: destination keys use incoming segment bearing; the director interpolates turning between keys rather than tracking the puck

coachPlayerRoutes.preview: selected player follows the planned keys, other players follow their own existing keys, and the puck follows its unchanged current carrier
coachPlayerRoutes.undo: one-step Undo route restores the prior draft while the applied draft remains current; another edit clears the undo
coachPlayerRoutes.persistence: pending points are local to the editor; Apply updates the working draft; existing Save draft and Export retain ordinary rinkreads-director-draft-v1 keys
coachPlayerRoutes.playbackBoundary: Animate play follows director keys; live practice starts from the initial setup and uses its own movement
